title: Insurance Claim Services Regulated-Scope Supplement Tear-Out Lines by Property Type
content:
| Property type on the Water Damage Mitigation job | Year built | Tear-out lines taken |
|---|---|---|
| multifamily unit or commercial property | before the asbestos sampling year cutoff (1981): 1980 or earlier | the flood cut and baseboard removal lines billed |
| single-family house or condominium unit | before the RRP year-built cutoff (1978): 1977 or earlier | the baseboard removal lines billed |
| any other combination | — | none |

**Rule.** For the Insurance Claim Services regulated-scope supplement, the regulated tear-out is taken as follows: for a multifamily unit or commercial property built before the water job tier's asbestos sampling year cutoff, the flood cut and baseboard removal lines billed on the job, because the asbestos NESHAP work practices govern tear-out in those buildings; for a single-family house or condominium unit built before the tier's RRP year-built cutoff, the baseboard removal lines billed on the job, because painted trim is the regulated surface the Renovation, Repair and Painting Rule governs there; otherwise no tear-out line.

Both cutoffs are the same on every Water Damage Mitigation tier: 1978 for RRP, 1981 for asbestos sampling. Lines are taken at the amount billed on the water job.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A multifamily unit built in 1980 with a flood cut of 655.20 and baseboard removal of 183.40: tear-out 838.60. Built in 1981: none.
- A single-family house built in 1977 with the same lines: tear-out 183.40, the baseboard removal only. Built in 1979: none, although it is earlier than 1981.
